idea-plugin.name: Extensions for arc42
idea-plugin.description:
Browse and check arc42 architecture documents written in AsciiDoc that use the extensions for arc42:

  • links: typed links between elements such as decisions, requirements, inputs and stakeholder roles
  • triggers: event-driven revisits of architecture decisions

The arc42 tool window lists the elements of each document by arc42 section or by kind. For each element it shows the links written at it, the links into it, and its revisit subscriptions and history. It reports violations of the links rules, follows include:: directives, and updates as you type.

Key Features

  • Real-time validation of 8 link rules (L1, L3-L8, B1) as you edit
  • Dual view modes: group elements by arc42 section or by element kind
  • Live updates: automatically refreshes as you edit AsciiDoc files (300ms debounce)
  • Navigation support: double-click or press Enter to jump to elements in source
  • Read-only interface: your documents remain the single source of truth
  • Works during indexing: no need to wait for IDE to finish indexing
  • Include directive support: follows include:: across multiple files

Independent project; not affiliated with or endorsed by arc42 or its creators.
